statement: The tenant portal shall mask personal data in every prompt before it is sent to a third-party language model, adding no more than 50 ms per prompt.
acceptance: Given 100 test prompts with emails, phone numbers and PAN values, when they are sent, then 100% of those values are replaced by tags and median added latency is 50 ms or less.
justification: Tenant prompts may hold personal data of Indian residents.
